GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Well Went Forward to lead .5 Lengths 600m lead .5 Lengths Straightened Up Under Pressure 2nd weakened badly final 200m Stewards: Vet check post race mare was 2/5 lame off foreleg. Vet clearance required prior to barrier trial/racing again # led/lame
Jumped Well , Went Forward led on rail x 1 length @ 600m. well off fence Straightening Up . Quickly tackled by winner, Gradually Gave Ground # led/faded Straight
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Shifted out on jumping and bumped another runner. Near the 100m was steadied when inconvenienced to the inside of another runner which shifted in slightly.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok , nice trail behind Fast Pace Leader 2 Lengths 800m, Hard Ridden when Leader sprinted from the corner, weakened last 200m # weakened last 200m
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly, shifted out and bumped another runner. Raced wide and without cover until approaching the 600m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 1 length on fence, held together much same to turn 2 Lengths rail, Lost Ground in straight. [Stewards: Post-race vet exam did not reveal any abnormality.] # no real excuses
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: A post-race veterinary examination of the filly did not reveal any abnormality.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok pressed on to lead 1 length clear, pushed along a touch turn, Straightened Up half clear, headed 200m and kept on ok to the line # led/headed 200m

Jumped OK. Pushed forward to lead on inside by 1 length early . Held lead on inside midrace & pushed to quicken Two Wide (1L clear) on home turn. Pressured Four Wide @ 250m & challenged @ 200m. Fought on well until shaded late. # Led - tried hard.
jumped well to lead from Wide barrier kept out 3 Wide 600m tired last 100m # speed/wide/tired
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Travelled wide and without cover throughout the event.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: (synthetic hoof filler first time) Jumped Fast Wide out , Quickly Crossed led on rail x 1 length @ 800m. $11 winner sitting 2nd. Headed by that horse into Straight . No Match but Kept Going Soundly enough to hold 2nd # led winner/sound
Jumped Well , Settled Down 3rd Inside 3 Lengths @ 700m. enjoyed rails trail then Clear early Straight Ridden Along Held Ground ok # Boxed On Evenly

Away fairly. Pushed fwd & raced 3rd 3 Wide No Cover (2.5L from lead) early . Worked to hold ground midrace & pushed to quicken Five Wide (3L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Five Wide @ 250m & boxed on OK in last 150m. # Wide/stuck on OK.
Jumped Ok pressed on, sat 2-3l off, under pressure turn and dropped out # poor
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Buffeted between runners at the start. Jockey reported that her mount, which was resuming today, failed to run out the journey of today’s event, with it weakening significantly in the home straight. A post-race veterinary examination revealed the filly to be experiencing a slow recovery rate.
